questions.q_en: Anita celebrated her birthday on Wednesday. Ashu celebrated his birthday 34 days after Anita. Deepak celebrated his birthday 5 days after Ashu, then on which day did Deepak celebrate her birthday?
questions.solution_en:
Anita celebrated her birthday on Wednesday.

Ashu celebrated his birthday 34 days after Anita.

Days repeat after every 7 days.

34 ÷ 7

Nearest multiple of 7 is 28

Remainder = 34 - 28 = 6

Odd days = 6

Wednesday + 6 = Tuesday.

Deepak celebrated his birthday 5 days after Ashu.

Tuesday + 5 = Sunday

Deepak celebrated her birthday on Sunday.
questions.solution_hi:
Anita celebrated her birthday on Wednesday.

Ashu celebrated his birthday 34 days after Anita.

Days repeat after every 7 days.

34 ÷ 7

Nearest multiple of 7 is 28

Remainder = 34 - 28 = 6

Odd days = 6

Wednesday + 6 = Tuesday.

Deepak celebrated his birthday 5 days after Ashu.

Tuesday + 5 = Sunday

Deepak celebrated her birthday on Sunday.

questions.q_en:
By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be correct?

3 and 9

I. 27 ÷ 3 X 18 + 9 - 36 = 21

II. 9 X 12 - 45 ÷ 3 + 16 = 109
questions.solution_en:
I) 27 ÷ 3 X 18 + 9 - 36 = 21

After interchanging 3 and 9

27 ÷ 9 X 18 + 3 - 36 = 21

54 + 3 - 36 = 21

57 - 36 = 21

21 = 21

Thus, equation I is correct.

II) 9 X 12 - 45 ÷ 3 + 16 = 109

After interchanging 3 and 9

3 X 12 - 45 ÷ 9 + 16 = 109

36 - 5 + 16 = 109

36 + 11 = 109

47 ≠ 109

Thus, equation II is incorrect.

Hence, the answer is an option (a).
